name: univer
description: Build your own AI office with Univer Office SDK. Bring editing, calculation, collaboration, and file processing into your product for people and AI agents. Built on an extensible open-source core.
one_liner: An open-source toolkit for building your own version of Google Sheets and Docs right inside your own product, so AI agents and humans can edit the same documents together.
buyer: A SaaS founder building a vertical business tool (for example, for accountants or logistics firms) who needs spreadsheet-like editing inside their product without building it from scratch.
business_use_cases: A vertical SaaS for accountants embeds a branded spreadsheet editor directly in their app instead of linking out to Excel or Google Sheets.
A startup building an 'AI data analyst' product uses it so both the AI agent and the human client can edit the same live spreadsheet together.
An internal tools team at a logistics company builds a custom collaborative planning sheet without paying for Google Workspace API limits.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a niche vertical app on top of it, like a spreadsheet-based invoicing tool for freelancers, rather than selling the SDK itself

steal_this: Pick one underserved niche, like rental-property books or freelance invoicing, and ship a branded spreadsheet app on top of it this weekend instead of competing with Excel directly.
